Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 44 (QTS missing-address campaign): checked this operators known Arizona facilities against this rows coordinates, ruled each out by distance or city mismatch, and declined to guess, flagged for future resolution.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] QTS Data Centers, formerly QTS Realty Trust, is a large scale data center provider. Per Blackstone Real Estate Income Trusts own press release, Blackstone affiliated funds completed a roughly 10 billion dollar acquisition of QTS Realty Trust on August 31, 2021, taking the company private. This specific row is one of two entries in this registry named simply QTS in or near Maricopa County, AZ, about 400 meters apart. This session checked this operators known Arizona facilities and could not confidently match any to these coordinates: QTS Phoenix, PHX1, sits at 120 E Van Buren St, downtown Phoenix, roughly 7 kilometers away, QTS Phoenix II Campus sits on the North 40th Street corridor, several kilometers away and, per a Data Center Dynamics groundbreaking report and the operators own current locations page, still partly under construction, and QTS Phoenix 3 and Phoenix 4 are in Glendale and Avondale, AZ respectively, different cities entirely. A separate 115 million dollar Chandler, AZ data center building purchase this session investigated turned out to belong to a different operator, Aligned Adaptive Data Centers, not QTS. No specific address is asserted for this row.
